description: Rename one of the user's saved searches or turn its new-match email alerts on or off. Pass saved_search_id from getmattered_list_saved_searches and name, alerts_enabled or both. Only the passed fields change, and they can be changed back with this tool. The search's roles and locations stay as they were saved. Nothing is sent to any employer and nothing is spent. Do not use it to change the job preferences; use getmattered_update_job_preferences. Next: getmattered_list_saved_searches.

alerts_enabled.description: true emails the user new matches for this search, false stops the emails.

name.description: The new name of the search, up to 120 characters.
